APLDS Course Requester

Office of APLDS (Alabama Principal Leadership Development System) — 2026-27 Directions

https://bit.ly/APLDSrequester

OVERVIEW

Role Overview

As a Course Requester for the Office of APLDS, you can:

  • Create courses through the Build button under the Professional Learning menu (note: new courses will also require approval by a Final Approver)
  • Create new sections in approved courses you submitted (note: new sections will also require approval by a Final Approver)
  • Access approved courses you created through the Build button under the Professional Learning menu and manage section rosters
PART 1

Create New APLDS Course

  1. 1

    Click the Professional Learning menu and then click the Build button on the left side of the screen.

  2. 2

    On the Build Courses and Sections screen, click the blue Build Course/Section button.

  3. 3

    Select Course Type (Instructor Led Course, Self-Paced Course, or PLC) and then click the Continue button.

  4. 4

    Next, give your course a Course Title using the naming convention, "APLDS – PL Provider: 2026-27 PL Title".

    RIC Example:
    • APLDS - RIC: 2026-27 Enhancing Library Media Programs Across Districts
  5. 5

    Choose the Office of APLDS (Alabama Principal Leadership Development System) from the dropdown list. (Note: If you have access to more than one Office in PowerSchool Professional learning, the Offices will be listed in Alphabetical order.) Finally, click the Create button.

  6. 6

    Enter a Course Description.

  7. 7

    Choose APLDS Clock Hours as the desired credit type and enter the number of hours.

  8. 8

    Choose Delivery Time Frame, Method of Delivery and indicate whether the training is data informed/data driven and research based. (Note: The professional learning experience must be data-informed/data-driven and research-based to count toward APLDS clock hour credit.)

  9. 9
    PLEASE NOTE: Leave the Bypass Course Approval dropdown option at - Not Selected -. Your course will need to be approved by a Final Approver (Anna Shepherd-Jones) for the Principal Act state-approved list.
  10. 10

    Choose ALSDE Default Survey for the Course Survey.

  11. 11

    Use the File Attachment feature to attach any desired documents to the course.

  12. 12

    When done with this part of the course form, click the blue Next button in the bottom right corner.

  13. 13

    Manage Course Alignment: 2024 Professional Learning Standards: On this screen, select the appropriate Alabama Standards for Professional Learning 2024. (Note: Make sure to click the dropbox and choose the new 2024 standards.)

  14. 14

    Manage Course Alignment: 2024 Alabama Standards for School Leadership: On this screen, select the appropriate Alabama Standards for School Leadership 2024. (Note: Make sure to click the dropbox and choose the new 2024 standards.)

  15. 15

    Click Next.

    📢 IMPORTANT: Both the 2024 Alabama Standards for Professional Learning and 2024 Alabama Standards for School Leadership must be added to the APLDS Course.
  16. 16

    Now choose Alabama Principal Leadership Development System (APLDS) as the Course Tag and click Next.

  17. 17

    Visibility: If desired, change the availability of your course by clicking the Manage Location button. This will determine who will be able to find your course and register. If your course is available statewide, this screen should display AL. If you are creating your course at the Regional level or District level, you will not be able to expand availability to a larger audience.

  18. 18

    Course Resources: Here you can add documents and resource hyperlinks by clicking the blue Add Resource button.

  19. 19

    If you are ready to create sections for your course, go to the Create New APLDS Section directions.

PART 2

Create New APLDS Section

  1. 1

    Click the Add Section button.

  2. 2

    Section Creation: Section Details

    • a

      Enter a Section Name and click the Add Section button.

    • b

      Notes: You can enter additional notes (including hyperlinks) in the Notes box.

    • c

      Contact Person: This is the person responsible for the training. Please provide contact information such as the email address.

    • d

      Presenter: This is the person who will conduct the training.

    • e

      Delivery Format: Choose from the dropdown list.

    • f

      Instructors: To add Instructors who will manage the section roster to print sign-in sheets, mark attendance and award credit, click the Add Instructors button. On the subsequent screen, you can search for and add Instructors for the section. (Always consider adding yourself as an Instructor. It will make it far easier for you to access section rosters later.)

    • g

      Location Settings: You must add a location. If the section is going to be conducted online, indicate such.

    • h

      Registration Settings

      • i.
        Enter the maximum number of participants.
      • ii.
        End of Registration Date. If you do not enter a date here, the section registration end date will default to the Start Date.
      • iii.
        Release to Catalog For Registration on: Choose the Date and Time at which the course/section will become active in the catalog for registration.
    • i

      Waitlist Settings: If you wish, click the check box to allow for a Waitlist and enter a number for the maximum waitlist size.

  3. 3

    Section Creation: Class Times

    • a

      Under the Class Time tab, make certain the toggle is set for "Populate start and end date based on class times". It should be in the green position.

    • b

      Click the Add Class Times button to add start date and time. If the training is going to take place over a number of days, you will need to click the Add Class Time button again to add additional days.

    📢 IMPORTANT: A Start Date and End Date must be added to each APLDS section. The 2026-27 APLDS dates are June 1, 2026 - April 30, 2027.
  4. 4

    Now that you have the Section Details complete and Class Times set, click the Submit Course and Section button.

    At this point, you will need a Final Approver (Anna Shepherd-Jones) in the Office of APLDS to approve your course and section(s).
